transcript: Speaker A: Does your brain work faster than you can type? How about working four times faster than usual? That's why I use Wispr Flow for a lot of my work, from sending emails, drafting my ideas, brainstorming, to turn my speech into text. It works perfectly in whatever app, and it adjusts the tone based on the app that I'm using. Even when I want to whisper, it gets it done because I am socially a bit awkward. Just try it out for free yourself.
on_screen_text: Does your brain work faster than you can type? / 4 times faster / Wispr Flow / You have no excuse to not work smarter
summary: The presenter introduces Wispr Flow, a speech-to-text tool that allows users to dictate text four times faster than typing. She demonstrates its features, such as tone adjustment and whisper recognition, and invites viewers to try it for free.
